name: write-create-and-overwrite
description: Create a new file in a nested directory, verify with read, then overwrite it.

name: write-archive-zip
description: Write a new member, replace an existing member, and write a nested member into an existing ZIP archive, then read listing and members.
setup: mkdir -p src && printf 'original\n' > src/old.txt && touch -t 202001010000 src/old.txt src && zip -q -X bundle.zip src/old.txt && chmod 644 bundle.zip && zip -q -X secret.zip src/old.txt && chmod 600 secret.zip && rm -rf src

name: write-archive-tar-and-targz
description: Write into existing TAR and TAR.GZ archives (new, replaced, and nested members) and read back listings and contents.
setup: mkdir -p pkg && printf 'tar-init\n' > pkg/a.txt && touch -t 202001010000 pkg/a.txt pkg && COPYFILE_DISABLE=1 tar -cf data.tar pkg/a.txt && COPYFILE_DISABLE=1 tar -czf data.tar.gz pkg/a.txt && rm -rf pkg

name: write-archive-create-missing
description: Write a member into a ZIP archive and a TAR.GZ archive that do not exist yet, then verify with read.

name: write-archive-errors-and-edge-cases
description: Exercise unsupported read-only format (.7z), non-stdlib omp-writable format (.tar.zst), directory or plain-file archive part, and invalid archive member paths.
setup: mkdir -p fake.zip && printf 'not a zip\n' > plain.zip && printf 'not 7z' > ro.7z

name: write-conflict-prefix-recovery
description: Write to an erroneously file-prefixed conflict URI (<file>:conflict://1) and verify prefix stripping, explanatory note, and resolved file content.

name: write-archive-tar-links
description: Rewrite a tar containing a regular file, hard link, file symlink, and directory symlink; verify rewritten member kinds and contents.
setup: python3 -B -c "import io, tarfile; tf = tarfile.open('links.tar', 'w'); d = tarfile.TarInfo('dir'); d.type = tarfile.DIRTYPE; d.mode = 0o755; tf.addfile(d); b = b'target text\n'; f = tarfile.TarInfo('dir/orig.txt'); f.size = len(b); f.mode = 0o644; tf.addfile(f, io.BytesIO(b)); h = tarfile.TarInfo('hard.txt'); h.type = tarfile.LNKTYPE; h.linkname = 'dir/orig.txt'; tf.addfile(h); s = tarfile.TarInfo('sym.txt'); s.type = tarfile.SYMTYPE; s.linkname = 'dir/orig.txt'; tf.addfile(s); ds = tarfile.TarInfo('dirlink'); ds.type = tarfile.SYMTYPE; ds.linkname = 'dir'; tf.addfile(ds); tf.close()"

name: write-archive-tar-broken-links
description: Exercise tar rewrite refusals for a dangling symlink and a hard link with a missing target.
setup: python3 -B -c "import tarfile; tf = tarfile.open('dangling.tar', 'w'); s = tarfile.TarInfo('bad.txt'); s.type = tarfile.SYMTYPE; s.linkname = 'nowhere.txt'; tf.addfile(s); tf.close(); tf = tarfile.open('missing-hard.tar', 'w'); h = tarfile.TarInfo('badhard.txt'); h.type = tarfile.LNKTYPE; h.linkname = 'ghost.txt'; tf.addfile(h); tf.close()"

name: write-archive-zip-symlinks
description: Rewrite a ZIP holding a file symlink and an unsafe-name member; test refusals for directory symlink, dangling symlink, and escaping symlink.
setup:
python3 -B -c "import zipfile
z = zipfile.ZipFile('zlinks.zip', 'w')
i = zipfile.ZipInfo('dir/orig.txt'); i.create_system = 3; i.external_attr = 0o100644 << 16; z.writestr(i, 'zip target\n')
s = zipfile.ZipInfo('sym.txt'); s.create_system = 3; s.external_attr = 0o120777 << 16; z.writestr(s, 'dir/orig.txt')
u = zipfile.ZipInfo('../escape.txt'); u.create_system = 3; u.external_attr = 0o100644 << 16; z.writestr(u, 'ignored\n')
z.close()
z2 = zipfile.ZipFile('zdirlink.zip', 'w')
i2 = zipfile.ZipInfo('dir/orig.txt'); i2.create_system = 3; i2.external_attr = 0o100644 << 16; z2.writestr(i2, 'zip target\n')
ds = zipfile.ZipInfo('dirlink'); ds.create_system = 3; ds.external_attr = 0o120777 << 16; z2.writestr(ds, 'dir')
z2.close()
z3 = zipfile.ZipFile('zdangling.zip', 'w')
b = zipfile.ZipInfo('bad.txt'); b.create_system = 3; b.external_attr = 0o120777 << 16; z3.writestr(b, 'nowhere.txt')
z3.close()
z4 = zipfile.ZipFile('zescape.zip', 'w')
e = zipfile.ZipInfo('esc.txt'); e.create_system = 3; e.external_attr = 0o120777 << 16; z4.writestr(e, '../outside.txt')
z4.close()"

arguments.command: python3 -B -c "import zipfile; z = zipfile.ZipFile('zlinks.zip'); print('\n'.join(f'{oct((i.external_attr>>16)&0o170777)} {i.filename}' for i in z.infolist()))"
